papers.title: Protection without teeth: semiclassical chronology protection on the Ori time machine
papers.summary: Hawking's chronology protection loses its force on the Ori time machine. The full image-series tensor gives a negative image-direction eigenvalue that follows the Misner law on approach, then the local eikonal horizon cuts it off at a finite, negligible level.

papers.title: Initial data for a time machine from dust: an explicit composite construction with a certified ordinary-density scaling regime
papers.summary: An explicit composite initial-data construction: vacuum pp-wave core, umbilical slice, dust envelope, and a verified hand-off to Ori outer layers. The full-layer retune makes both gates positive; ordinary density is a certified scaling extrapolation at depth.

papers.title: Quotient structure and on-generator diagnostics of vacuum traveling-wave time machines
papers.summary: Xavier's vacuum traveling-wave metric admits a switchable quotient, but the closed null generator carries the same epsilon-to-the-minus-two and epsilon-to-the-minus-four singularity as Misner. A sector-level structure and discriminator paper.

papers.title: A search for boost-holonomy relics in the gravitational-wave catalog
papers.summary: A boost-holonomy relic leaves an exact mass-scaling signature in gravitational waves. The corrected catalog and posterior cuts return a null, with 82 of 120 Stage-3 pairs surviving and a shared-base cluster at p = 1.000.

papers.title: A Gaia search for boost-holonomy relics: the full-sky co-spatial radial-velocity pair census
papers.summary: The completed full-sky Gaia radial-velocity pair census finds no significant signal. The family statistic is calibrated against a composition-matched null: permissive p = 0.737, strict p = 0.969. 16,358 raw pairs yield 939 permissive and 135 strict candidates.

papers.title: A Bose-Einstein condensate analogue of Misner space: a design study of the kinematic image-sum mechanism
papers.summary: A design study of a BEC analogue of the Misner image-sum mechanism. The 314 micrometre image needs about 0.08 nK and the 157 micrometre antipodal correlation about 0.16 nK; B3 to B6 remain open and B1, B2, B7, B8 and B9 are fixed, so it is not a ready proposal.

papers.title: Time travel: a critical review
papers.summary: A critical review of the time-travel program: chronology protection, constructive machines, the quantum stress computations, the relic searches, and the acquisition and engineering ledger.

papers.title: Acquisition, not assembly: the classical manufacture problem for a boost-holonomy time machine, and the three routes to obtaining one
papers.summary: The matter in a boost-holonomy time machine can be assembled, but the identification cannot be manufactured by the known classical routes. The paper maps the three acquisition routes and states the 3+1 proof gap.

papers.title: The engineering ledger of a time machine: mass, wrap, siting, and the resource class of an acquired relic
papers.summary: The engineering ledger for a time machine: mass and density rungs, the wrap, siting at 0.008 to 0.12 AU, and the resource class of an acquired relic. The wrap is asteroid-industry scale; the survey is civilization-scale.
